subject.title: refactor(cli)!: remove automatic gateway→embedded fallback from openclaw agent

question: Should `openclaw agent` permanently replace its released automatic embedded fallback with a fail-closed Gateway error, requiring callers to choose a later retry or explicit `--local` run?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility and operator-workflow change, not a mechanical cleanup: existing scripts can move from a successful local response to a non-zero exit during Gateway transport loss.

options.title: Accept fail-closed transport handling
options.body: Merge after real-run proof confirms that the error path never starts an embedded turn and the operator guidance is safe for ambiguous accepted turns.

options.title: Preserve fallback behind an explicit mode
options.body: Keep current recovery as the compatibility default and introduce an opt-in strict mode only if maintainers decide existing automation needs that transition path.

options.title: Pause for broader CLI contract discussion
options.body: Defer the removal until maintainers decide whether the fallback behavior is a supported automation contract and how long any migration window should last.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed transport handling
recommendation.body: Merge after real-run proof confirms that the error path never starts an embedded turn and the operator guidance is safe for ambiguous accepted turns.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recently merged fallback behavior and this replacement proposal, so they are best placed to provide the technical contract history for the maintainer decision.
